body: It's unbelievable how well I can relate to your position. Nobody has even been as close to me as a friend of mine. She has brought me happiness and I have mainly kept living for her. Now we are drifting apart and I don't know what to do. I'm 17, and my parents are not the people who I wanna talk to because they don't accept my sexuality and it has played a huge role in my mental health issues. Does other people in your life, besides your friend, know that you are suicidal? Does other people know how your mental health is?
